rule: each unit song × flavour, Oak's whole song with no take, offline before the master limiter: integrated loudness never over min(its flavour's Band median + 2 LU, that flavour's loudest Band) and never more than 2 LU under that flavour's quietest Band (the Bands measured on this pack by the calibration test as sound-wave5.json measures them: one bar at 96 BPM; the aim, ±2 LU of the median, is reported per song); sample peak under −1 dBFS; the song's flavours within 3 LU of each other; the loud parts (chorus, lift, drive) at least 1 LU over the quiet parts (intro, verse, bridge, vamp, of 4 bars or more) on average; energy under 120 Hz between a third of and 1.15 times the flavour's Bands' median share; each take step's reference answer, as the live Make in its sections: the learner's tracks alone at most 3 LU under Oak's tracks alone there, in every flavour. Budget: later runs within 1 LU (loudness, takes) and 1.5 dB (peaks) of the numbers recorded here.

bands.rule: every Band (content/bands) in every flavour, every stage unlocked, in C major (a minor Band in A minor): one bar at 96 BPM (a waltz in 3), rendered offline through render.html before the master limiter, as wave5.pw.ts measures sound-wave5.json's Bands; mix loudness (LUFS), peak (dBFS) and energy under 120 Hz (%)
